title: Zigbee ZCL: Improve Thermostat Cluster support
description:
Noticed some attributes of Thermostat cluster are displayed as _"Unknown"_. Also _ClearWeeklySchedule_ command is _"Unknown"_.

This MR completes Thermostat's attribute names list and add empty dissector _ClearWeeklySchedule_ command (no payload).
